task.question: In which French commune was the highest local temperature (44.3 °C) recorded during the record hot day of 23 June 2026?
task.evidence: 23 June – France experiences its hottest day on a national scale, with an average temperature of 29.8°C (85.6°F) across the country, beating the previous record of 29.4°C. The highest locally recorded temperature is 44.3°C, in Pissos.

answer:
Perfect! I found the answer. According to the Wikipedia article on "2026 European heatwaves," on June 23, 2026, which was declared France's hottest day since measurements began in 1947, the highest local temperature of 44.3 °C (111.7 °F) was recorded in **Pissos**.

FINAL: Pissos
